name: hex_launch
for: hexer hex: cast at the open hand
notes: Three violet tendrils wind in and knot tight at the hand while motes are drawn in (frames 1-4), then a rune ring flashes open around the knot and a few curse sparks spit forward (+x) as a dark puff rises; the runes crumble away in blocks. Anchor = the casting hand. 10 frames @10 fps; the wisp (hex_flight) should leave on frame 5.
